name: Transportation Commission Special Meeting - City's Comprehensive Environmental Sustainability Plan
agenda_text:
CITY  OF  ALHAMBRA

  NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE
  TRANSPORTATION COMMISSION
  (Notice No. N2M24-13)

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the City of Alhambra will be hosting a virtual
workshop to welcome stakeholders for the development of the City’s Comprehensive
Environmental Sustainability Plan on Thursday, January 24, 2024, at 2:00 p.m. on the
topic of Mobility and Land Use, with meeting registration via Zoom at
https://kearnswest.zoom.us/j/82644628397.

It is intended that this virtual meeting shall be led by the City’s Consultants
Environmental Science Associates and Kearns & West. However, due to the possibility
that six (6) or more members of the Transportation Commission may attend this
meeting, which will include a discussion of priority environmental action items that
should be considered for Alhambra, notice of a special meeting of the Alhambra
Transportation Commission is hereby given.

  LUCY GARCIA, ASSISTANT CITY MANAGER

Dated: January 23, 2024
Notice No. N2M24-13
